text: The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. Here is the consequential distinction: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. That does not negate its use; it limits its adequacy for the stated purpose. This is not approval for broader rollout. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout. Put more precisely, the evidence is informative within a narrower decision boundary, but insufficient for the wider one.
